title: Municipal permit intake and public notices
not_questions: The clerk maintains the current permit instructions in Drupal.
We will not license Adobe Target for this award.
Enter one response per row and state where the clerk must make a policy decision.
Snowflake contains the monthly permit service statistics supplied to council.
never_in_text: Municipal permit intake and public notices

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe how AEM Forms would distinguish a resident submitting a new street closure permit from a clerk correcting the same application at the counter.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain how AEM Forms would save a partially completed permit when a resident has not yet obtained a supporting sketch.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Provide an AEM Forms validation example for a closure that spans midnight and blocks access to a neighboring property.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Describe the evidence from an AEM Forms rehearsal in which a clerk returns a permit for correction and the resident resubmits it.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe how you would migrate the clerk's seasonal permit instructions from Drupal to AEM Sites while preserving bookmarks on printed notices.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how AEM Sites would distinguish a proposed closure notice from an approved one when residents search by street name.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Provide an AEM Sites schedule for publishing a hearing notice and withdrawing it when the meeting moves to a different date.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Describe how the clerk would verify a translated AEM Sites notice against the adopted English notice before either appears on the municipal website.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Name the delivery lead your firm will send to the counter pilot and specify how many days that person will be on site.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide a municipal reference that can verify your team's work with clerks and residents during a permit service change.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: State the amount payable at pilot acceptance and the rate for an additional council demonstration outside business hours.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Describe your firm's handover terms for training material that the clerk's office intends to reuse for seasonal staff.

questions.label: D.1
questions.text: Describe how Acrobat Sign would capture the required signatures on a multi-block closure agreement when the two ward offices approve it on different days.

questions.label: D.2
questions.text: Identify the staff member your firm will assign to the council sign-off meeting and state the charge for a second appearance if the meeting is adjourned.

questions.label: D.3
questions.text: Explain how Customer Journey Analytics would reconcile incomplete online permit journeys with the monthly Snowflake workload report before council sees the figures.

questions.label: D.4
questions.text: Provide an AEM Assets handoff for an approved detour diagram when a traffic engineer replaces the diagram on the afternoon of a street closure.
